text:
Amir: Heads-up — I'm in the Berlin office tomorrow and want a quick lunch near Kreuzberg. Prefer: no nuts (allergy), vegetarian ok, under €12 ideally. Any recs?

Leah: Ooh lots of good spots. 'Mama's Döner' on Adalbertstrasse does vegetarian falafel-döner and they label nuts. Cheap and fast.

Klaus: +1 Mama's. Portions are huge. If you want sit-down and slightly nicer, 'Pho & Co' (Oranienstr) has a vegetarian pho and bun bowls, usually under €10-12.

Marta: if you want something lighter, 'Good Morning' (Morgenstrasse?) has shakshuka and GF toast options but it's a 10-12 min walk.

Amir: are any of those okay for nut allergy? I can eat sesame but not tree nuts.

Leah: Mama's falafel uses tahini (sesame) but no tree nuts afaik. Pho & Co sometimes uses crushed peanuts as garnish, but they keep it separate — ask for no peanuts.

Klaus: when in doubt, say `no nuts` and they'll usually accommodate. German places are pretty good about that, but always safe to double-check.

Marta: also FYI most cash registers accept card but bring a few euros. Mama's is cash+card.

ops-bot: quick logistics: Kreuzberg office has a microwave and a set of labeled allergy knives in the kitchen. Please return them after use. If you want, we can pre-order for pickup — ping Facilities 30m before.

Amir: perfect. Time-wise I have to be back by 1:30pm. Thinking Mama's at noon or Pho & Co at 12:15. Which has fastest line?

Leah: Mama's is faster for takeaway at noon. Pho & Co sometimes queues but moves quickly.

Klaus: Mama's = 10-15 min. Pho & Co = 15-25 min at lunch.

Marta: if it's raining, Pho & Co has better indoor seating. Mama's is a bit cramped. :umbrella:

Amir: thanks all — going with Mama's at 12:00. Anyone want to join?

Leah: I'll come but might be 5 min late.

Klaus: can't make it, but enjoy.

Marta: I'll join, meet at lobby at 11:55.

Amir: awesome. I'll message if plans change. Thanks for the recs and the allergy tips. :raised_hands:
